messages:
anna.dev: kicking off staged bundle validation for private-vpc release 2026-03-20-rc2. packaging uploaded to s3://prod-airgap/2026-03-20-rc2, awaiting signoff + release-notes final text. please check checksums and installer hooks.

kevin-packaging: checksum uploaded, installer image pinned. please use these for verification:
```
bundle.tar.gz sha256: a3b1c4d5e6f7890ab12c3d4e5f678901234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1
installer.bin sha256: f1e2d3c4b5a697887766554433221100ffeeddccbbaa99887766554433221100
```

mike.releases: added a short release note draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/releases/2026-03-20-rc2-notes (please edit). tagging the staged PR and the canary window at 30m.

sylvia-sre: starting canary now (hosts: canary-1..5). ops will watch metrics (cpu, io, kernel logs). if >2 hosts fail in 30m we abort.

deploy-bot: Canary start: manifest=2026-03-20-rc2 targets=5 window=30m. monitors=[k8s-pods, node-disk, app-liveness].

deploy-bot: Canary progress: 1/5 ok, 2/5 ok, 3/5 failed (installer: nfs mount timeout on step 4). logs: https://logs.internal/canary/3765432100/3

jamal-ops: seeing the same nfs timeouts in staging earlier today. probably needs retry/backoff in installer. recommend abort canary and repack with fix, unless packaging has a hotpatch. :warning:

kevin-packaging: confirmed root cause: installer didn't wait long enough for mount propagation in some customer VPCs. small patch ready to push to bundle. will rebuild and republish new bundle+digest in ~25m.

anna.dev: decision call: abort canary and roll back to previous manifest for canary targets. keep rollout window reserved for later today. I'll update release notes with "canary aborted - known nfs mount fix pending". :thumbsup:

mike.releases: agree. rollback command (tested):
```
deploybot rollback --manifest 2026-03-20-rc2 --targets canary --reason "nfs mount timeout - abort canary"
```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for manifest=2026-03-20-rc2 targets=canary. actions=stop-installers, revert-k8s-images, notify-ops. ETA ~3m.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: 5/5 canary targets reverted to manifest=2026-02-28-stable.

sylvia-sre: good. keeping monitoring up for 1h to ensure no lingering degradations. please attach the fixed bundle digest when ready.

kevin-packaging: rebuilt bundle and pushed new digest: sha256: 9f8e7d6c5b4a39281726354433221100abcdefabcdef1234567890fedcba98. New installer includes retry/backoff for NFS mounts and extra logging.

anna.dev: once kevin confirms artifact signed, mike please re-open canary. mike.releases: I'll wait for kevin to paste cosign signature and for legal to sign release note change.

kevin-packaging: cosign signature for new bundle: sig: cosign:eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9... (shortened). checksum and signature are in s3 and signed-manifests bucket.

mike.releases: new canary kicked at 3765432600, window=30m. target pass criteria: >=4/5 success and no regressions in latency. If success >=90% after 30m, we proceed to staged rollout.

sylvia-sre: monitoring hooks configured. alert if installer fails >1 host or error rate spike >0.5%.

anna.dev: release-notes updated with canary abort section + fix summary. will mark images pinned to digests in the notes and in the packaging checklist.

jamal-ops: reminder for onprem customers: we will publish patch advisory with KMS/manifest digest and a clear rollback command snippet. ops to prepare KB article.

mike.releases: timeline note: if new canary passes by 18:30 UTC we can proceed to staged rollout at 19:00 UTC. else postpone to tomorrow morning.

kevin-packaging: thanks all — repackaging follow-up done. I'll post final artifact links and checksums in this thread when they fully replicate to offline mirrors. :white_check_mark:
